edition.authority: International Commission on English in the Liturgy Corporation, whose translation this is; delivered by the Liturgy Office of the Bishops' Conference of England and Wales
edition.jurisdiction: The universal ICEL English, common to ICEL's eleven member episcopal conferences. THE HOST IS NOT THE TERRITORY. The document carries no England-and-Wales adaptation, its own notices claim only Libreria Editrice Vaticana, ICEL and the Revised Grail, and its foreword cites the GIRM of the 2011 Roman Missal; the Liturgy Office is its delivery route and not its authority.
edition.publication: A 265-page PDF whose title page reads ANTIPHONARY EXCERPTED FROM THE ROMAN MISSAL / RENEWED BY DECREE OF THE MOST HOLY SECOND ECUMENICAL COUNCIL OF THE VATICAN, PROMULGATED BY AUTHORITY OF POPE PAUL VI AND REVISED AT THE DIRECTION OF POPE JOHN PAUL II / ENGLISH TRANSLATION ACCORDING TO THE THIRD TYPICAL EDITION / 2010. Published free and entire by the Liturgy Office of the Bishops' Conference of England and Wales at https://www.liturgyoffice.org.uk/Missal/Music/Antiphonary.pdf, whose page describes it as "the ICEL Antiphonary" and adds that a Word version is available on request; state retrieved 2026-08-21.
edition.title: Antiphonary excerpted from The Roman Missal — English translation according to the third typical edition, 2010 (the ICEL Antiphonary)
translators: International Commission on English in the Liturgy Corporation
